I'm calling from Dr. Garcia's office to confirm an appointment tomorrow for Zeyneb Rashad.
You're scheduled to see the doctor at 1 p.m. for a tooth cleaning and then...
I see you've also scheduled a whitening procedure.
That'll be conducted by one of our assistants.
The whitening process is different for each patient.
I hope the rest of your afternoon is free.
Oh, and I see that we've already received payment for all the work tomorrow, so there won't be any need for you to pay at the end.

您安排在下午 1 点看医生进行牙齿清洁，然后……
我看到您还安排了美白程序。
这将由我们的助理之一进行。
美白过程对每位患者都是不同的。
希望您下午剩下的时间是空闲的。
哦，我看到我们已经收到了明天所有项目的付款，所以您不需要在最后支付任何费用。
